Name: Pokemon Eggventure - Pets
Author: Parme69
Description:
[size=5][b]Pokémon Eggventure - Pets[/b][/size]

[i]"Pika!"[/i]

Every trainer remembers the first one. In Pokémon Yellow, you didn't get a Poké Ball — you got a Pikachu who refused to stay in it and followed you everywhere instead.

This module brings that companion to Stardew Valley. Your cat or dog is replaced by a Pikachu that trots after you around the farm, naps on your rug, sits in the doorway waiting for you to come home, and answers with a real cry from the games when you scratch its ears.

[size=4][b]Twelve Pikachu to choose from[/b][/size]

Every Pikachu in this pack is drawn from the games — the Contest costumes of Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire, and the travelling caps of Sun & Moon.

[b][u]Cosplay Pikachu[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Wizard Pikachu[/b][/*]
[*][b]Libre Pikachu[/b][/*]
[*][b]Ph.D. Pikachu[/b][/*]
[*][b]Pop Star Pikachu[/b][/*]
[*][b]Rock Star Pikachu[/b][/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Cap Pikachu[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Partner Cap Pikachu[/b][/*]
[*][b]Sinnoh Cap Pikachu[/b][/*]
[*][b]Hoenn Cap Pikachu[/b][/*]
[*][b]Unova Cap Pikachu[/b][/*]
[*][b]Alola Cap Pikachu[/b][/*]
[*][b]Kalos Cap Pikachu[/b][/*]
[*][b]World Cap Pikachu[/b][/*]
[/list]
Each one is a separate breed with its own sprite sheet and its own icon in the selection menu, so you can see exactly which one you're picking.

[size=4][b][u]Gifts[/u][/b][/size]

Look after your Pikachu and it starts leaving things on your doorstep. What it brings depends on how much it trusts you.

[list]
[*][b]Two hearts[/b] — a [b]Magnet[/b]. Nothing else, every time. Feed it to an Energy Extractor and it becomes Electric Energy.[/*]
[*][b]Three hearts[/b] — a Magnet or a [b]Battery Pack[/b], an even split.[/*]
[*][b]Five hearts[/b] — Magnet half the time, Battery Pack or [b]Omni Geode[/b] the rest.[/*]
[/list]
No fish, no rabbit's foot, no junk. Everything your Pikachu brings home is something an Electric-type would plausibly dig up — and it plugs straight back into the Eggventure energy economy rather than shortcutting it.

[size=4][b][u]Features[/u][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Pick one at character creation[/b] — the Pokémon appears alongside the cat and the dog when you start a new farm.[/*]
[*][b]Or adopt one later[/b] — all twelve breeds are available from Marnie.[/*]
[*][b]A rewritten adoption event[/b] — Marnie finds a stray Pokémon sitting outside your farm gate and asks whether you'd like to keep it. Fully written new dialogue, and your Pikachu reacts throughout the scene.[/*]
[*][b]The real cry[/b] — pet your Pokémon and it answers with its cry, straight from the games.[/*]
[*][b]Full pet behaviour[/b] — it walks, sits, sleeps on your bed or your rug, and shows up in the Summit ending like any vanilla pet.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49098][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49098]Pokémon Eggventure - Day Care[/url][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install Content Patcher and Pokémon Eggventure - Day Care.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Languages[/b][/size]

English and French. Translations are welcome — everything is in the [font=Courier New]i18n[/font] folder, and I'll add any language you send me.

[size=4][b]Part of Pokémon Eggventure[/b][/size]

This is one module of a larger project that turns Stardew Valley into a Pokémon world:

[list]
[*][b]Day Care[/b] — the core pack. Over 1200 Pokémon raised as farm animals, with eggs, incubation, shinies, evolutions and type energies.[/*]
[*][b]Follow Me[/b] — summonable Pokémon companions.[/*]
[*][b]Junimo, Bobbers, Digspot, Giftbox, Introduction[/b] — and more.[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Feedback[/b][/size]

Bug reports and suggestions are very welcome in the Posts tab. If a Pikachu misbehaves, tell me which breed and what it was doing — it helps more than you'd think.

Gotta catch 'em all.
